name: Stream
motion: Fine particles follow a living flow field; pointer interaction bends the field, which gently reforms.

name: Kinetic
motion: Matte letter forms rise and settle in a travelling wave; the foreground identity remains stable.

name: Current
motion: A slowly evolving color field responds to a soft cursor lens; scroll opens the project gallery.

name: Fold
motion: An oversized fabric banner responds to virtual wind and pointer movement, then stretches into the first project.

name: Contour
motion: A continuous 3D contour surface ripples softly; cursor pressure sends a travelling deformation across it.

name: Assembly
motion: Matte components assemble into a single system, then separate into project chapters on scroll.

name: Lightwell
motion: A slow camera move through a sculptural corridor creates depth; project previews emerge at its openings.

name: Relay
motion: Signals travel along continuous routes; selecting AI or payments highlights its path and relevant projects.
